The `remember` tool was supposed to save the fact privately to Dana. Instead, GBrain marked it `visibility: "world"`, so other people who can read that source may be able to pull it up with `recall`. It's a minor operational detail, but it did come from a direct message. Since rule 2 says what someone tells me in a DM stays with them, you may want to switch this fact to private, or remove it with `forget` and save it again privately.
